about_the_game:
Get a hands-on preview of Realm Watch, the upcoming wave defense, tower building adventure set in a dark fantasy world! This demo offers a focused single-player experience.

What's Inside:

  • Four Playable Heroes: Experiment with different playstyles.

  • The First Map: Learn the ropes and defend against enemy waves.

  • Core Gameplay: Build defenses, fight hordes, and unleash hero skills.

While the full game will feature 4-player co-op, an expanding story, new levels, RPG elements and more, this demo lets you dive straight into the action today. Test your mettle, choose your hero, and prepare for the battle ahead!
